aboutMe.firstBlock:
# I build the infrastructure that makes AI agents reliable in production.
{years} years of full-stack engineering across Vue, React and Node.js; since the start of 2025, on what happens after a demo works: isolation, evaluation, cost, and the failure modes nobody writes about.

I run my own multi-agent platform daily and know precisely where it breaks.
aboutMe.secondBlock:
Most of my work is unglamorous by design: a gate an agent cannot push past, a git worktree that survives a paused sandbox, recon that costs 13.6× less than it used to.

The interesting part isn't making something work once — it's knowing what it does on the bad day.

 **The code for this site is open on GitHub.**
